name: Can accessible furniture space planning improve my home's resale value?

mainEntity.name: Can accessible furniture space planning improve my home's resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: While not a primary driver for all buyers, accessible features can increase a home's appeal and resale value, particularly in areas with an aging population or for buyers seeking universal design. Homes that are thoughtfully planned for accessibility can attract a broader market, as they offer long-term comfort and safety for diverse needs. It signals a well-considered and future-proofed property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, accessible planning can broaden appeal and potentially increase resale value, especially to those seeking universal design or future-proofed homes.
